privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy informs you about how personal data is processed when you use Tone Force (tone-force.lovable.app).

mic.title: Microphone access
mic.body: Tone Force needs microphone access for tone-based controls. Audio is analyzed locally in your browser (pitch detection) only, to translate tones into game inputs. Nothing is recorded, transmitted to a server, or stored. You can revoke microphone access at any time in your browser settings, or use the demo mode without a microphone.

storage.title: Local storage
storage.body: We store technically necessary preferences exclusively in your browser's localStorage: language preference, settings such as difficulty / volume / instrument, triad selection, highscore cache, and a marker indicating whether you have already been counted this session. This data does not leave your device and can be cleared at any time via your browser settings.

visitors.title: Visitor counter
visitors.body: We count page views on the home page anonymously for reach measurement. No IP address, no user agent, and no unique identifier is stored — only a numeric counter in our database is incremented. Identification of individual visitors is not possible.

highscores.title: Highscores
highscores.body: When you save a highscore entry after a game, the name you enter (freely chosen, a pseudonym is fine) is stored together with score and level reached in our database and shown in the public leaderboard. You don't have to provide a real name. You can request deletion at any time by emailing info@trumpetstar.com.

hosting.title: Hosting & backend
hosting.body: Tone Force is hosted on the Lovable platform (Lovable.dev). Backend functions (visitor counter, highscores) run on Lovable Cloud. When you visit the site, technically necessary connection data (IP address, HTTP request) is processed in server logs, kept only briefly for delivery and abuse prevention.

tracking.title: No tracking, no advertising
tracking.body: We do not set tracking cookies, do not use analytics tools (e.g. Google Analytics), no retargeting, and no advertising networks. Embedded third-party content is limited to the sponsor logo and a link to the partner site trumpetstar.com — that site is only loaded when you click.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection under the GDPR. You may also lodge a complaint with the Austrian data protection authority (dsb.gv.at).

contact.title: Contact for privacy questions
contact.body: For any questions or to exercise your rights, please contact: info@trumpetstar.com
